decls.description: Anything a domain reads as a part of a whole, as a whole with parts, or as both. A view supplies its elements.

slots.description: The direct whole this is a part of. At most one: the parts form a forest. Absent for a whole that is part of nothing.
How many times this part occurs in its direct whole. Absent when it occurs once.

lines: // Rules of std-part, in the Datalog subset, so Soufflé is the oracle.
// The base relations are the theory's tables: constituent__part_of(part, whole) and
// constituent__repeat(part, n). Two axioms are checks of the schema: a constituent has at most one direct
// whole (part_of is single-valued), and repeat is at least 1.
// within: the transitive closure of part_of. x is part of w, directly or through wholes in between.
within(x, w) :- within(x, v), constituent__part_of(v, w).
// has_whole: x is a part of some whole. Its absence is the ground of outermost: "w is a part of nothing".
// outermost: the whole x is within that is itself part of nothing. In a forest every part has exactly one.
// Axiom: part_of is irreflexive and acyclic. Nothing is part of itself, directly or through others.

module.description: Part and whole. A constituent is part of at most one direct whole, and may occur in it more than once. The axioms make the parts a forest: nothing is part of itself, directly or through others. The derived relations are in rules/part.dl. The mapping annotations compare with SKOS and Dublin Core; no rule reads them.
